newsitem.title: USA: AK Steel to build $1.1 bln processing plant.
newsitem.headline: AK Steel to build $1.1 bln processing plant.

text.p: AK Steel Holding Corp said on Thursday it would build a $1.1 billion carbon and stainless flat-rolled steel processing complex on 1,700-acres in Indiana, which would significantly enhance product mix.

The plant would proccess about 1.8 million tons of carbon and stainless sheet steel a year, for automotive, appliance, food and chemical processing markets, the company said. It would create about 400 jobs, AK Steel said.

The facility, to be built near the Ohio River community of Rockport, was expected to enhance the company's value-added product mix, AK Steel said. Construction was expected to begin in early 1997, it said.
The capital investment would be about $1.1 billion, the company said.
